newsitem.title: INDIA: India VSNL shares up on NSE after GDR.
newsitem.headline: India VSNL shares up on NSE after GDR.

text.p: Shares of telecommunications firm Videsh Sanchar Nigam Ltd (VSNL) rose 67.50 rupees, or 6.9 percent, to 1,039 on the National bourse on Tuesday in low volumes, brokers said.
They said some speculators were picking up the stock after its issue of global depositary receipts (GDR) was oversubscribed on Monday.
VSNL said on Monday its GDR issue had been priced at $13.93 per GDR, or 1,000 rupees per VSNL share. It said in a statement the issue had been oversubscribed about 10 times.
Each GDR represents half an ordinary VSNL share.
There were no early trades in VSNL shares on the Bombay Stock Exchange, brokers said.
